name: koha-plugin-libris-catalogue-import
description: Nightly import of new and changed bibliographic records from the Libris (National Library of Sweden) MARC21 export API, staged through Koha's import batches so matching and overlay rules apply

scripts.release:patch: node check_release_ready.js && node increment_version.js patch | cat && PLUGIN_FILE=$(node -p 'require("./package.json").plugin.pm_path') && git add package.json CHANGELOG.md "$PLUGIN_FILE" && git commit -m 'chore: bump version' && VERSION=$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version') && git tag -a v$VERSION -m "Release v$VERSION" && node ensure_workflows_enabled.js && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: node check_release_ready.js && node increment_version.js minor | cat && PLUGIN_FILE=$(node -p 'require("./package.json").plugin.pm_path') && git add package.json CHANGELOG.md "$PLUGIN_FILE" && git commit -m 'chore: bump version' && VERSION=$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version') && git tag -a v$VERSION -m "Release v$VERSION" && node ensure_workflows_enabled.js && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: node check_release_ready.js && node increment_version.js major | cat && PLUGIN_FILE=$(node -p 'require("./package.json").plugin.pm_path') && git add package.json CHANGELOG.md "$PLUGIN_FILE" && git commit -m 'chore: bump version' && VERSION=$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version') && git tag -a v$VERSION -m "Release v$VERSION" && node ensure_workflows_enabled.js && git push origin main --follow-tags

author: Open Fifth
